title: adverse event case processing: before and after

before.label: today: manual
before.total: ≈ 86 min of pharmacovigilance time per case (blended)

steps.task: Log the source in the safety database, record the receipt date, check the four minimum criteria
Search the safety database for duplicates by patient, product, event and dates
Enter patient, reporter, products, events, history and lab data into E2B(R3) fields
Code events, indications and medical history in MedDRA
Assess seriousness and expectedness against the SmPC
Check the data entry, coding and narrative against the source
Medical review of serious cases: seriousness, expectedness, company comment
Generate and submit the E2B(R3) file, check the acknowledgement, track the deadline

after.label: agent workflow
after.total: ≈ 21 min of pharmacovigilance time per case (blended)

steps.task: Ingest call-centre notes, emails, literature and partner E2B files; stamp the receipt time
Separate adverse events from queries and complaints; check the four minimum criteria
Score candidate duplicates that code found by patient, product, event and dates
Fill E2B(R3) fields from the source, with a verbatim quote behind every field
Choose LLTs from dictionary candidates; code checks each is current in the version in force
Propose seriousness criteria and expectedness against SmPC section 4.8, citing the text
Draft the case narrative from the coded, structured case
QC every case; medical review and sign-off of every serious case
Track 15- and 90-day clocks, validate the E2B(R3) file, submit to EudraVigilance, read ACKs
